ci._maxAutodiscoverUrlsIsNotOptional: maxAutodiscoverUrls: 0 means NO CAP. Do not delete it and do not set it to a number. With staticDistDir and no explicit `url` list, @lhci/cli autodiscovers pages and then imposes a DEFAULT CAP OF 5 as a silent .slice(0, 5) — no warning, no log line, no non-zero exit. Discovery order is root files first, then subdirectories alphabetically, so at the seven pages this branch is building toward it would have audited /, /about, /contact, /faq and /find-your-helper, and dropped /pricing and /why-directhired. Every assertion below — performance, accessibility, SEO, LCP, CLS, TBT — would have stopped applying to the highest-value page on the site while CI stayed green. staticDirFileDiscoveryDepth is left at its default of 2, which already reaches the nested routes.

assert._comment: aggregationMethod: 'median' (not the lhci default 'optimistic', which grades every assertion on the single best of the 3 runs and would mask a regression that shows up in only 1 or 2 of them).

ci._totalBlockingTimeIsInpLabProxy: The design budget is INP < 200ms, but INP is a field metric (real-user CrUX data) that Lighthouse cannot measure in a single-page lab run. total-blocking-time above is the standard lab proxy for JS-driven responsiveness, asserted at the same 200ms threshold as the INP budget -- it is NOT a measurement of INP itself, and a passing TBT does not guarantee a passing field INP.
